jobs.occupation: Administrative Assistant - Real Estate - Full Time or 4/5th
jobs.description:
As Administrative Assistant, you will provide operational and administrative support to the Estates team. The position would suit someone who genuinely enjoys administrative coordination, document follow-up and contract management, and who is comfortable working in a dynamic environment. You are fluent in French, Dutch and English. The position is possible in 4/5th of Full Time.

 

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international company managing an extensive real estate portfolio across Belgium.The company offers a stable environment, a collaborative culture and the opportunity to contribute to projects that have a tangible impact across the country. They are located in Diegem and easily accessible by car, tram, bus and train.

 

Description

• Support administration and follow-up of lease renewals, acquisitions and ongoing property files.
• Review contracts, interpret and gather relevant information.
• Manage correspondence and DocuSign signature processes.
• Ensure accurate filing and document management.
• Follow up with landlords regarding contractual and administrative matters.
• Support invoice processing and administrative reporting.
• Prepare reports, presentations and meeting documentation.
• Coordinate with various internal stakeholders and ensure proper follow-up of actions.

• A few years of experience in an administrative, coordination, file managment or property-related support role.
• Exposure to property management, lease administration, real estate, notary or similar environments is a strong asset.
• Proactive; organised and adaptable personality, able to support different stakeholders and managers.
• Professional level French and Dutch, with a good level of English.

• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment.

Our client is an established international professional services organization.

Jobomschrijving

• Map and document end-to-end processes across the different Business Services functions.
• Meet with key stakeholders to understand how processes are currently performed in practice.
• Document current-state ("as-is") processes, including responsibilities, systems, approvals and dependencies.
• Identify gaps, inconsistencies and opportunities to create clearer and more efficient ways of working.
• Develop practical future-state ("to-be") processes and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
• Create clear process documentation using tools such as Visio or PowerPoint.
• Ensure critical operational knowledge is properly captured and documented.
• Review and centralize existing supplier contracts, including ownership, expiry dates, renewal periods and key obligations.
• Review insurance arrangements and help identify potential gaps, overlaps or inconsistencies.
• Establish a practical approach for monitoring contract renewals, expiry dates and related actions.
• Collaborate with Procurement and Legal to ensure the appropriate contracts and governance are in place.
• Review and improve processes related to signing rights and delegated authorities.
• Take end-to-end ownership of deliverables and ensure the work progresses independently with limited day-to-day supervision.

• Demonstrated experience as a Business Process Consultant, Process Improvement Consultant, Business Operations Consultant or process-oriented Business Analyst.
• Strong hands-on experience with business process mapping and documentation.
• Able to conduct stakeholder interviews and translate complex information into clear and practical processes.
• Experience creating as-is/to-be process maps and SOPs.
• Previous exposure to contract management, supplier governance or operational governance is highly valuable.
• Strong analytical and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Autonomous and execution-focused: you are comfortable taking ownership and delivering the work from start to finish.
• Pragmatic and hands-on profile rather than purely strategic or advisory.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Fluent English, both written and spoken, is required.
• Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a strong advantage.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to support the development and maintenance of an Azure-based data platform, ensuring data is accessible, high-quality, and fit for purpose.This is a hands-on, execution-focused data engineering role, where you will work primarily on SQL transformations, data pipelines, and platform optimisation. You will contribute to building robust and scalable data solutions that enable analytics and reporting across the organisation.Key Responsibilities

• You build, monitor and optimize data pipelines using Azure Synapse and Data Factory
• You design and optimize data storage solutions (Azure Data Lake, Synapse Analytics)
• You develop and maintain scalable SQL transformations
• You ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across the platfform
• You collaborate with analysts and business teams to deliver reliable and usable datasets
• You support data governance, security, and compliance requirements

Your Profile 

• You bring solid experience in data engineering (min. 5 years), preferably within an Azure-based environment
• You have completed a master’s degree in Data, IT, or Economics, or you possess an equivalent level of analytical and practical skills based on your experience.
• You have strong SQL skills and experience with modern data platforms and transformation processes
• You communicate fluently in English, knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

As an operator, you play an important role in the production process of metal components. You work with modern machines and ensure that each piece is bent and cut according to the correct specifications. Quality and precision are central to your job.

You start your day by preparing and positioning the pieces. Next, you set up the machine correctly, start it up, and monitor the entire production process. You thoroughly check each finished product to make sure it meets quality standards. You work in a structured and accurate way, and you'll have the chance to learn a lot on the job.

Are you interested in working with metal and eager to learn the trade? This is your opportunity! Apply quickly and become our new operator.

• You speak and understand English well, basic Dutch is a plus
• You are motivated, accurate, and eager to learn
• Experience in production is an advantage but not required
• You are available to work full time (40 hours/week)
• You can perform quality checks and enjoy hands-on work

jobs.description:

Welder – Two-Shift Work
Job description
Looking for a full-time welding role in automotive parts manufacturing? This opportunity in Zwevegem starts as an interim assignment with the option of permanent employment. You’ll work with tube products and a range of materials.
A tube-products manufacturer
The company specializes in manufacturing tube products.

Forum Jobs connects talent and companies through a personal approach and broad sector knowledge. As a full-service HR partner, it supports both candidates and employers, bringing a human touch to the recruitment process and helping people find opportunities that fit.

You’ll feel at home in this role if careful, skilled welding and pride in a quality finish are your kind of work.

• You notice the small details that make a difference and take pride in delivering high-quality work.
• You enjoy working as part of a team, adapt flexibly, and make safety a priority for yourself and those around you.
• You can communicate in English, Dutch, or French, and can provide a reference from a former employer.

jobs.occupation: Technician in day shift - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the area of Oostkamp or Bruges
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not obligated, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC... The company can teach you these on the job.

Responsibilities

• Translate functional requirements into detailed technical designs and program structures.
• Develop and maintain backend software using mainframe technologies and modern development tools.
• Create and execute comprehensive test cases and perform technical integration testing.
• Conduct self and peer code reviews to maintain high quality and performance standards.
• Analyze and resolve incidents and defects to ensure system reliability.
• Participate in a standby rotation to ensure continuous service availability.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in backend development within a mainframe environment.
• You have solid technical expertise in COBOL, PL/1, EGL, and DB2.
• You bring experience with development and versioning tools such as IDz workbench, Changeman, and GitHub.
• You possess the ability to translate business needs into functional and technical specifications.
• You're experienced in working with Agile methodologies in complex environments.
• You are proactive, analytical, and capable of working independently while collaborating with diverse stakeholders.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience in financial markets and investment banking.

jobs.occupation: Account Receivable & Credit Officer - Brussels - Food Sector
jobs.description:
Our client is a family-founded multinational company, leader in the global packaged goods industry, known for producing high-quality consumer products. Originating in Europe, the company has expanded its footprint to over a hundred countries, maintaining a strong presence in both mature and emerging markets.

Jobomschrijving

• Verification and recording of accounts receivable data
• Processing of incoming payments
• Compliance with group financial policies and procedures
• Preparation of invoices 
• Management of bank deposits
• Following up with clients to facilitate invoice payments
• Regular communication with clients
• Financial data analysis and report creation
• Monitoring credit-related performance indicators (KPIs)
• Implementation of action plans to ensure the company's financial health

• Minimum 3 years of experience as an A/R Officer or in a similar role
• Trilingual proficiency in Dutch, French, and English, enabling effective communication with diverse stakeholders
• High accuracy and attention to detail in work, especially in record-keeping
• Strong critical thinking skills to support precise and efficient operations
• Proficient in Excel and SAP, with hands-on technical knowledge
• Proactive problem-solver, addressing technical challenges with practical solutions
• Solid experience in credit collection and understanding of its accounting complexities
• Valuable contributor to effective management of accounts receivables

Our client is an EU organization based in Brussels. Offices are reachable by public transports.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage administrative mailboxes and general office correspondence.
• Register and review invoices while maintaining accurate supplier records.
• Prepare payments and support budget and expense management activities.
• Liaise with external accountants and maintain accounting documentation.
• Manage membership fees, donations and other contributions.
• Monitor contracts, deadlines, renewals and procurement procedures.
• Prepare and maintain administrative and financial reports, trackers and overviews.
• Review project documentation to ensure contracts, invoices and supporting documents are complete and properly filed.
• Support the preparation of documentation for audits, compliance reviews and public authorities.
• Coordinate office suppliers, equipment, inventory and external service providers.
• Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding processes.
• Maintain well-organised administrative records and contribute to the improvement of internal procedures and workflows.
• Provide general administrative, operational and compliance support as required.

• Minimum 1-2 years of experience in administration, office management or accounting support.
• Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Good command of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
• Reliable, proactive and solution-oriented approach.
